about: Modwerk source-only digistring packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/digistring.

mods.title: STRING
mods.summary: A Karplus-Strong plucked string SRC machine: bowed, hit, noise or plucked strings that go through the Digitakt's own AMP, filter, mixer and effects.
mods.description: A Karplus-Strong plucked string SRC machine: bowed, hit, noise or plucked strings that go through the Digitakt's own AMP, filter, mixer and effects.
mods.author: Alez22
mods.on_unit: Emulator-checked on OS 1.53 (machine list and SRC page); on hardware the author tested the OS 1.54 build of the same 0.8.0 source for 30 minutes.

mods.title: STRING
mods.summary: A Karplus-Strong plucked string SRC machine: bowed, hit, noise or plucked strings that go through the Digitakt's own AMP, filter, mixer and effects.
mods.description: A Karplus-Strong plucked string SRC machine: bowed, hit, noise or plucked strings that go through the Digitakt's own AMP, filter, mixer and effects.
mods.author: Alez22
mods.on_unit: The author tested 0.8.0 on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.54, with Core 2.1 and STRING alone, for 30 minutes (2026-10-27): machine list, SRC page, exciters, locks, LFO, save/reload and stock machines work; four STRING tracks play cleanly, with more than four the UI lags.
